profile.headline: Software Engineer at Greenhouse Software
profile.summary: Nature Lover, Lifelong Learner. I am interested in applying technology to support and encourage sustainable lifestyles.

company.name: The New York Code + Design Academy

positions.title: Youth Coordinator and Web Developer
positions.description:
• Recruited and on boarded new departmental staff
• Created and led instructor training program
• Created and updated office safety protocols and new hire
  policies and procedures
• Engaged in community outreach and fostering partnerships
  to promote coding and STEM courses in schools
• Developed engaging, age appropriate curriculum for youth
  coding programs
• Designed, built and managed the construction of the youth
  initiative satellite website

positions.title: Web Development Intensive || Student
positions.description:
A full-time, 12 week intensive program to learn the fundamentals of front and back end development. 
Skills: Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, Test Driven Development, Git, HTML, CSS, SASS, Bootstrap, jQuery, Database Theory, Postgres, MySQL, Sinatra.

positions.title: Youth Coordinator
positions.description:
• Supervised, trained and evaluated 30 staff
• Performed general administrative tasks, such as
   scheduling, editing internal paperwork, weekly payroll and
   making phone calls
• Maintained and updated records on program children and
  department staff
• Analyzed revenue and program cost data to determine
  budget priorities; decreased supply costs for both camp
  and after school programming
• Created budgets and statistical analyses of program
  enrollment
• Designed and implemented local marketing campaigns
• Designed and facilitated youth programming including day
  camps, after school care and special interest courses

positions.title: Youth Counselor
positions.description: I provided art, sport, and language instruction for elementary aged children.

volunteerExperiences.description: I raised funds for Children's Miracle Network and participated as a dancer for the Dance Marathon held at the University of North Florida.
I helped to cook and serve food to members of the homeless community.
